description: The blog collection in the CMS with a mixed set: two published posts and two drafts. Draft state is now real data the schema declares, so the list can distinguish them — before this change zod stripped the field and every entry looked published. The drafts are withheld from the production build entirely; they remain visible here and under astro dev so an author can finish them.
